sample_unit: lateral cephalograms (30 each of skeletal Class I, II, III)

links.outcome: GPT performance on cephalometric diagnosis and treatment planning (AIDTI 0-10) by prompt format
links.effect: Text-based prompts scored up to 9.62 ± 1.13 (GPT-5 pro); image-based prompts scored much lower, best 4.16 ± 4.12 (GPT-o3 pro). Models systematically classified malocclusions as Class II.
links.quote: By contrast, the performance of all GPTs on image-based prompts was notably lower, with the highest score being 4.16 ± 4.12 for GPT-o3 pro.

unlisted_practices: Using a domain-specific structured scoring index (AIDTI) to evaluate LLM diagnostic and treatment-planning responses in orthodontics
Providing text-based numeric measurements instead of direct image upload as the input format

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial multimodal foundation models on cephalometric diagnosis and treatment planning across text vs image input modalities without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
